name: portal
description: Bun-powered file upload/download portal with drilldown UI

scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d && docker compose logs -f
scripts.docker:publish: npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && docker build -t ${PORTAL_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/OWNER/portal}:${PORTAL_TAG:-latest} . && docker push ${PORTAL_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/OWNER/portal}:${PORTAL_TAG:-latest}
scripts.docker:refresh: docker compose build && docker compose up -d && docker compose logs -f
